ORAL ORDER 2 04-02-2026 Heard Mr. Manoj Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Ashok Kumar Singh, learned APP for the State.
2.
The petitioner has prayed for bail in connection with Kotwa P.S. Case No. 438 of 2022 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 411, 467, 468, 471, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The case of the prosecution in short is that the co- accused, namely, Jhunnu Singh, has disclosed the role of this petitioner that he punches the engine of the stolen bike and also prepares duplicate documents.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.

He has been falsely implicated in this Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.4946 of 2026(2) dt.04-02-2026 case.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that nothing has been recovered from the possession of this petitioner.
The name of this petitioner has surfaced only in the confessional statement of the co-accused, namely, Jhunnu Singh.

He also submits that from perusal of the order of the learned trial court, it will transpire that the learned trial court has recorded that as para 5 of the supplementary case diary, the engine number and chassis number of Shyambabu Rai @ Shyambabu Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122878626/

5. The application for bail is opposed by learned APP for the State.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
The above named petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rs. ten thousand only) with two sureties Patna High Court CR.
